name: Physics Core
description:
Low-level physics utility for projectile arcs, knockback impulses, and gravity-affected motion used by combat and movement bricks.

AND IT IS NOT ONLY SIDE-VIEW. Gravity into a vertical axis is the platformer's physics, and it was the only physics this catalogue's runtime had: a top-down vehicle has no floor to fall to. What it has is a HEADING, and the whole feel of driving lives in how much of its velocity points along that heading versus across it. `planar` is that decomposition — forward speed, lateral speed, slip angle — and it belongs here rather than in a vehicle component because it is arithmetic, and movement.vehicle_tuning, progression.drift_scoring and combat.ram_damage_model all need the same answer to "how sideways is this". Grip applies to the lateral component alone: a car that grips loses its sideways speed and keeps its forward speed, which is what grip means and what scrubbing both would destroy.
